# Documentation Templates Guide

This directory contains standardized Markdown templates for maintaining consistent documentation across the RecoLab repository.

---

## 📑 Available Templates

1. **`model-documentation-template.md`**
   - Use when creating technical specification files for new recommendation algorithms or models.

2. **`api-documentation-template.md`**
   - Use when documenting Python modules, public classes, functions, or protocol interfaces.

3. **`guide-documentation-template.md`**
   - Use when writing operational, developer setup, workflow, or troubleshooting guides.

---

## 📏 Usage Guidelines
- Always copy the template into the appropriate destination directory before populating content.
- Ensure all placeholder sections (`[Bracketed Text]`) are fully completed.
- Maintain Google-style formatting for code examples and Python type annotations.
